tasks.title: Fence New note until the Notes component finishes initial loading
tasks.body:
Goal:
Prevent New note entry from racing asynchronous component initialization.

Current behavior:
The actual native failure and component/controller source establish an enabled entry window while initial loading remains unfinished. Source causality is verified by a held-store component control before implementation.

Touch:
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/Components/NotesPanel.razor`
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/State/NotesController.cs`
- `tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/Notes/NotesPanelTests.cs`
- `tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/Notes/NotesFixture.cs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-notes-entry-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-adapters.json`
- `.skill-tree/documents/features.md`
- `.skill-tree/documents/ux-ui-manifest.md`
- `.skill-tree/documents/testing.md`

Implementation constraints:
Preserve scoped Notes source/drafts, unknown receipts, conflict/consent guards, dirty-draft reviews and native controls. Use component-owned initialization state; no retry, arbitrary delay, command acceptance or provider operation. Do not hide unrelated errors or claim device/release acceptance.

Validation:
Use runnable held-load Red before implementation, then Green, current Release fixtures and native read locks with explicit release/cleanup. Preserve original failures.
